vr1102c.title: Sony MZ-R90 MD Walkman Portable MiniDisc Recorder Silver Remote Earphones

vr1102c.details: Sony MZ-R90 MD Walkman portable MiniDisc recorder in silver with Digital Mega Bass. Condition: there are scratches and scuffs from age, as shown in the photos. Included, as shown in the first photo: the recorder, the external battery case, a remote control (RM-MZ2S) and a pair of earphones. No AC adapter, disc or box is included. Please see the photos for the exact condition and the included items.
